title: 第27章 了断因果
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
黄昏，柳溪镇西街。

    茶馆门前挂着破旧的布幡，堂内茶客稀疏。

    陈凡换上一身不起眼的青色散修长袍。

    他抬手拂面，易容符的灵力渗入皮肉，将那张蜡黄的面容微微揉合，化为一张毫无特征的普通散修面孔。

    他跨过门槛，径直走向靠窗的偏僻角落。

    “客官，喝点什么？”

    一个透着疲惫的女声在桌旁响起。

    陈凡拉低斗笠，平静地抬眼看去。

    短短时日，小姑娘林小婉已变成了女人模样。

    然而，长期的粗重劳作在她身上留下了难以磨灭的痕迹。

    她的脸色透着苍白，眼角带着细微的纹路。

    此时正值寒春，她露在袖口外的手指关节红肿，长满了冻疮，几处皮肉绽开，隐见血迹。

    陈凡体内的筑基期神识微微一扫，林小婉的身体状况便了然于胸。

    长期的焦虑与苦力活已经耗尽了她的气血。

    凡人本就只有短短数十载寿命，以她如今的底子，恐怕活不过五十岁。

    若无意外，她此生最好的结局，也不过是在这边缘小镇上寻个老实的凡人车夫或铁匠，勉强糊口，安稳度日。

    “一壶粗茶。”

    陈凡收回神识，嗓音低沉。

    “好咧，客官稍等。”

    林小婉并未在这张陌生的面孔上停留目光，勤快地擦了擦桌角，转回后厨。

    片刻后，她端来一只边缘缺口的粗瓷茶壶和大碗，稳稳倒满，便转身去收拾旁边的空桌。

    陈凡端起茶碗，抿了一口。

    茶水苦涩，满是碎渣，与仙家灵茶相比无异于泥水。

    但他神色未变，在放下茶碗的刹那，右手食指微不可察地在木桌边缘一抹。

    一个巴掌大小、质地粗糙的青色瓷瓶无声地立在桌角的阴影里。

    瓶内装着三颗通体圆润、散发着微弱药香的丹药——固元培本丹。

    此丹无法精进法力，是一阶极品丹药中极为罕见的凡人延寿偏方，由凡世顶级老药辅以温和灵力炼制，是陈凡此前在林家老祖的储物袋深处翻找出来的。

    凡人若每隔十年服用一颗，可化解体内积攒的所有暗伤与病灶，无疾而终，安稳活过九十岁。

    这东西对修士形同鸡肋，但对林小婉而言，却是凡人一生都求不来的长命机缘。

    瓷瓶下方，还压着一张对折的粗糙白纸。

    上面只有两行字，是用最寻常的粗重笔锋写就：

    “十年服用一颗，谢当年一饭之恩。”

    “此后因果两清，安稳过余生，不必寻我。”
content_en:
Dusk, West Street, Liuxi Town.

    There are shabby cloth banners hanging in front of the teahouse door, and there are only a few teagoers in the hall.

    Chen Fan put on an inconspicuous blue casual robe.

    He raised his hand to brush his face, and the spiritual power of the disguise talisman seeped into his skin, slightly kneading the sallow face, turning it into a featureless face of an ordinary cultivator.

    He crossed the threshold and walked straight to the remote corner by the window.

    "Sir, what would you like to drink?"

    A tired female voice sounded from beside the table.

    Chen Fan lowered his bamboo hat and looked up calmly.

    In just a short period of time, the little girl Lin Xiaowan has transformed into a woman.

    However, long-term heavy labor left indelible marks on her body.

    Her face was pale and there were subtle lines at the corners of her eyes.

    It was cold spring at this time, and her finger joints exposed outside the cuffs were red and swollen, covered with frostbite, and the skin was split in several places, with blood stains visible.

    Chen Fan's foundation-building spiritual consciousness in Chen Fan's body was slightly swept away, and Lin Xiaowan's physical condition was clearly understood.

    Long-term anxiety and hard work had exhausted her vitality.

    Mortals only have a short lifespan of a few decades. With her current condition, she may not live to be fifty years old.

    If there were no accidents, the best outcome for her would be to find an honest mortal coachman or blacksmith in this marginal town to make a living and live a stable life.

    "A pot of crude tea."

    Chen Fan withdrew his consciousness and spoke in a low voice.

    "Okay, sir, wait a moment."

    Lin Xiaowan did not stop looking at this unfamiliar face, wiped the corner of the table diligently, and turned back to the kitchen.

    After a while, she brought over a rough porcelain teapot with a chipped edge and a large bowl, filled them steadily, and then turned to clear the empty table next to her.

    Chen Fan picked up the tea bowl and took a sip.

    The tea is bitter and full of debris, which is no different than muddy water compared with Xianjia Ling Tea.

    But his expression did not change. The moment he put down the tea bowl, his right index finger imperceptibly touched the edge of the wooden table.

    A palm-sized, rough-textured cyan porcelain bottle stood silently in the shadow of the corner of the table.

    The bottle contains three round-shaped elixirs with a faint medicinal fragrance - Guyuan Peibendan.

    This elixir cannot improve mana. It is an extremely rare first-class elixir to extend the life of mortals. It is made from the top old elixirs in the world and supplemented with gentle spiritual power. Chen Fan found it in the depths of the storage bag of the ancestor of the Lin family.

    If an ordinary person takes one pill every ten years, he can resolve all the hidden wounds and lesions accumulated in his body, die without any disease, and live safely over ninety years old.

    This thing is useless to a monk, but to Lin Xiaowan, it is an opportunity for longevity that a mortal can never ask for in his life.

    Under the porcelain bottle, there is a piece of rough white paper folded in half.

    There are only two lines of words on it, written with the most common thick strokes:

    "Take one pill every ten years to thank you for the meal."

    "From now on, both cause and effect will be clear, and you will live the rest of your life in peace, without having to look for me."
